opening_hook: Har roz ek hi waqt pe uthna, bas ek hi cheez, aur usne apni poori zindagi badal di.
narration: Rohan ek aam ladka tha, jo roz socha karta tha ki kal se padhai shuru karega. Par kal kabhi nahi aaya. Phir ek din, usne decide kiya ki woh roz sirf ek page padhega, chahe kuch bhi ho. Usne apni phone notifications band kar diye, aur subah jaldi uth kar apni desk pe baith gaya. Pehle toh usko bahut mushkil laga, par dheere dheere yeh ek aadat ban gayi. Ek hafte baad, usne dekha ki uska focus badh gaya hai, aur uske grades bhi improve ho rahe hain. Usne samjha ki consistency hi asli magic hai. Bas roz ek choti si koshish, aur phir dekho kya hota hai.
